prompt_head:
Job: Solutions Architect at Smartsheet
<requirements>
- (required) 3 years relevant work experience or equivalent combination of relevant work experience and ed

paragraphs.text: The Solutions Architect opening at Smartsheet emphasizes end‑to‑end full‑stack delivery and AI integration. My four‑plus years as a systems architect have been spent designing, building, and shipping production‑grade platforms that run on edge infrastructure and combine UI, backend, and LLM services. I routinely explain system design to non‑technical stakeholders, a skill sharpened by direct customer engagements.

I built tycodes.app, a web service that turns a business URL into a live, shoppable 3D demo in about a minute. The system runs a six‑stage agent pipeline on Cloudflare Workers, uses Vite, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind for the UI, and calls OpenAI through a Hono worker for pricing models. I added a verification stage that stops unsupported claims from publishing, eliminating hallucinated pricing. I architected linkme‑intops, an operations CRM module built with React and TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers. The tool gives staff a dedicated interface for high‑value subscription accounts and serves as the front end for a suite of integration blueprints that onboard enterprise clients. I also engineered custom data ingestion modules and analytics pipelines that cut service delivery time by over 30%. A zero‑maintenance serverless backend I built used Google Sheets via OAuth, removing the need for dedicated servers.

I have not yet taken regular travel beyond local client sites, so the 15 % travel requirement is a gap for me. I will address it by aligning travel with project milestones, using remote preparation to keep onsite time focused, and scheduling trips well in advance to meet Smartsheet’s needs.
I would welcome a conversation to discuss how my full‑stack and AI‑agent experience can support Smartsheet’s solutions.
